text.insert: Build an ordered operation batch against the stable IDs and current hash returned by prompts_read. The complete batch either validates and saves or leaves the canonical prompt unchanged.

Use the editing address map to select block IDs. It is separate from the production render, which is the actual model-facing text. Block nodes nested beneath list items are addressable; list items themselves are edited through their owning list block.

rows: Shallow-merge supported fields into a block. Reject unknown fields, incompatible values, changed identity/type, and no-op patches.

text.insert: Compile operations in array order against a scratch document. Later operations may address nodes inserted earlier in the same batch. Preserve existing IDs through updates and moves, and give inserted nodes descriptive IDs that do not collide with the document.

A collision causes the inserted subtree IDs to be regenerated by the shared insertion machinery. Read the returned document and address map before referring to those nodes again. Never infer an inserted ID from the submitted request alone.

Errors identify the offending operation. Read unknown targets again, repair invalid fields or container choices, and retry the complete batch with the current prompt hash. A stale revision requires reconciling the new document before retrying; a task ID never overrides that conflict.

Profile findings can remain during a sequence of saves. Structural errors and undeclared variables block saves. Finish with prompts_check after inspecting the production render, then prompts_end. Use prompts_undo with the committed change ID and current hash to undo a save without overwriting intervening changes.
